Screenshots were captured on devices and simulators. Information reflects the time of capture and may differ from the released app. Screenshots show the Japanese interface; this English website does not indicate English-language support in the apps.

From train positions.
To your next departure.

See train positions, check departures at nearby stations and search for a route. Find the information you need for everyday travel on iPhone or Apple Watch.

Train positions

Where is your train?
At a glance.

See station names and train positions along a line, including whether a train is moving or stopped at a station. Select a train to see more details.

Departures and service updates

Your next departure.
Service changes, too.

See destinations, departure times and available delay information on a station's departure board. Everything to check before travelling, in one view.

Station timetables

Planning ahead?
Check the timetable.

Switch between weekday and holiday timetables to find a train for your preferred departure time.

Train details and sharing your train car

Know your train.
Share your car.

See the destination, current position and stops. On the sharing screen, choose a car to prepare to share the station and your position on the train. Choose who to share with before sending.

Supported lines and operators

  • JR East
  • Toei Subway
  • Keikyu
  • Tobu Railway
  • Keio
  • Yokohama Municipal Subway

Available train position data varies by operator, line and section. Check the line selection and information in the app for coverage. Service updates and route search have different coverage from train positions.

Data sources

Uses data provided through the Public Transportation Open Data Center (ODPT). Information may be delayed by provider updates or connection conditions. This app is developed independently of railway and transit operators.

About ODPT ›

Toei Subway data: Bureau of Transportation, Tokyo Metropolitan Government, and Association for Open Data of Public Transportation. Applicable data licence: CC BY 4.0. Train position data and other data are adapted for display.

Have a question?

This website introduces and supports apps developed by Shimayu. The apps are independent and are not official apps of railway companies, transit operators or Apple.
Train positions and timetables may be delayed or inaccurate. For the latest information, follow station announcements and official operator information.
